description_en: Call this API to create a queue
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi cloud-create-queue --enterprise-id 7000002 --queue ServiceLevel=10 AnnounceSound=0 WrapupTime=30 MaxLen=0 Description=queueName AnnouncePosition=0 AnnounceSoundFile=announceSoundFile3 CreateTime=2026-04-20_10:00:00 QueueTimeout=80 AnnounceSoundFrequency=10 AnnouncePositionYouarenext=0 AnnouncePositionParam=2 MemberTimeout=25 Weight=8 JoinEmpty=1 Qno=3003 MusicClass=default Strategy=rrordered Retry=5 SayAgentno=true VipSupport=1 AnnouncePositionFrequency=0 --queue-skills SkillLevel=10 SkillId=66 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloudCreateQueue

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.name: enterprise_id

fields.help_en: The service level threshold in seconds. Calls answered within this time meet the service level target
fields.help_zh: 服务水平秒数，低于此时间内接听的认为是高服务水平
fields.name: service_level

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to play a fixed announcement. Valid values:
• 0: Off
• 1: On
fields.help_zh: 播报固定语音 0关闭 1打开
fields.name: announce_sound

fields.help_en: The wrap-up time, in seconds. Valid range: 3 to 3,600
fields.help_zh: 整理时间，取值范围3-3600秒
fields.name: wrapup_time

fields.help_en: The maximum number of callers that can wait in the queue. The valid range is 0 to 999. A value of 0 indicates no limit
fields.help_zh: 最大等待数，设置范围0-999，0表示不做任何限制
fields.name: max_len

fields.help_en: The name of the queue
fields.help_zh: 队列名
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
Specifies the condition for announcing a caller's position in the queue. Valid values:
• 0: Off
• 1: Announce when the position is greater than the `AnnouncePositionParam` value.
• 2: Announce when the position is less than or equal to the `AnnouncePositionParam` value.
fields.help_zh: 位置播报 0关闭 1大于announce_position_param时播放 2小于等于announce_position_param时播放
fields.name: announce_position

fields.help_en: The audio file for the fixed announcement
fields.help_zh: 固定语音文件
fields.name: announce_sound_file

fields.help_en: The time when the queue was created. The format is `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`
fields.help_zh: 创建时间，格式: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
fields.name: create_time

fields.help_en: The queue timeout period in seconds. The value must be between 20 and 600. The default value is 600
fields.help_zh: 队列超时时间，取值范围20-600秒，默认600秒
fields.name: queue_timeout

fields.help_en: The interval, in seconds, at which the fixed announcement is played
fields.help_zh: 播放固定语音周期，秒数
fields.name: announce_sound_frequency

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the "You are next in line" announcement.
• 0: Off
• 1: On
fields.help_zh: 是否播报'您是下一位',0关闭，1开启
fields.name: announce_position_youarenext

fields.help_en: The threshold for the position announcement, used with the `AnnouncePosition` parameter. The value must be greater than or equal to 2
fields.help_zh: 多余少余n个时播报，必须大于等于2
fields.name: announce_position_param

fields.help_en: The time in seconds an agent has to answer a call before it is rerouted
fields.help_zh: 座席超时时间，取值范围20-60秒，默认25秒
fields.name: member_timeout

fields.help_en: The queue priority. The value must be between 1 and 10. A higher value indicates a higher priority
fields.help_zh: 队列优先级，取值范围1-10，数值越高，优先级越高
fields.name: weight

fields.help_en:
A bitmask that defines which agent statuses are considered unavailable for routing when a call enters an empty queue. Valid statuses:
• 1: Busy
• 2: In a call
• 4: Ringing
• 8: Invalid
• 16: Wrap-up
fields.help_zh: 队列中为空时是否可以join，取值：1：置忙 2：通话中 4：振铃 8：无效 16：整理
fields.name: join_empty

fields.help_en: The queue number
fields.help_zh: 队列号
fields.name: qno

fields.help_en: The music-on-hold class
fields.help_zh: 等待语音class
fields.name: music_class

fields.help_en:
The call strategy used to route calls to agents. Valid values:
• `rrordered`: Skill Priority
• `rrmemory`: Round-robin
• `fewestcalls`: Fewest Calls
• `random`: Random
• `linear`: Linear
• `leastrecent`: Longest Idle
fields.help_zh: 呼叫策略：rrordered:技能优先 rrmemory:轮选 fewestcalls:平均 random:随机 linear:顺序 leastrecent:最长空闲时间
fields.name: strategy

fields.help_en: The delay, in seconds, to wait before trying the next agent if the current one does not answer
fields.help_zh: 座席超时无应答,呼叫下一座席的延迟秒数
fields.name: retry

fields.help_en:
Enables or disables the agent number announcement. Valid values:
• true: Announce
• false: Do not announce
fields.help_zh: 语音报号，true:播报，false:不播报
fields.name: say_agentno

fields.help_en:
Enables or disables VIP support for the queue. Valid values:
• 1: Enabled
• 0: Disabled
fields.help_zh: 是否支持vip，1:支持，0:不支持
fields.name: vip_support

fields.help_en: The interval, in seconds, at which the caller's position in the queue is announced
fields.help_zh: 位置播报周期，秒数
fields.name: announce_position_frequency

parameters.help_en: The configuration details of the queue
parameters.name: queue

fields.help_en: The skill level
fields.help_zh: 技能值
fields.name: skill_level

fields.help_en: The ID of the skill
fields.help_zh: skill的id
fields.name: skill_id

parameters.help_en: The skills associated with the queue
parameters.name: queue_skills
